name: ai-sdlc
description: The six-stage AI-native software development lifecycle from Anthropic's playbook, as an executable Claude Code plugin. Each stage produces one version-controlled Markdown artifact and stops at a human gate: Plan writes intent.md (problem, outcome, constraints, open questions), Design turns an accepted intent into spec.md under org skills, Build reviews and then implements plan.md, Test proves the change and regression-tests the agent config itself with evals, Deploy runs the REVIEW.md passes (bugs, security, compliance) on the PR with a verifier pass and a round cap, and enforces approval gates via hooks, Maintain watches bands.yaml control bands and files the next intent.md when a band breaks. A change a person declares low-risk takes the fast path, entering at Build; the hooks refuse it for any sensitive path. Ships 8 skills (six stages plus /ai-sdlc-init and /ai-sdlc-status), a reviewer subagent that also serves as plan reviewer and finding verifier, a control-band diagnostician, artifact-gate and prod-guard hooks, and templates for intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, review-findings.md, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md and bands.yaml.
